summary: Powell County, MT log cabin lookout dated 1928 and abandoned 1949 by firelookout.com; FFLA lists the site as gone; no source describes it today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

events.note: Log cabin per firelookout.com; the page says the crow's nest sat atop Packrat Mtn

evidence.supports: built 1928 as a log cabin; crow's nest atop Packrat Mtn; abandoned 1949
evidence.quote: 1928: log cabin. Crows nest atop Packrat Mtn. Abandoned 1949.

evidence.supports: lookout carries the Tillson Peak name
Packrat Mountain listed under Powell County in the index
Powell County section heading in the index; Packrat Mountain and Tillson Peak are listed under it
Tillson Peak listed under Powell County in the index
FFLA lists Tillson Peak in Powell County as a ground lookout that is gone

notes_for_editor: Only two short lookout pages and the FFLA list say anything about this site. firelookout.com names the lookout Tillson Peak but puts the crow's nest on Packrat Mtn; the Forest Lookouts index lists both peaks under Powell County. The record's coordinates are for Tillson Peak, so the location is unverified. No staffing, fire or present-day source found; two web searches returned nothing on this lookout.
